name: @sparrowengg/twigs-intellisense-extension
description: Monorepo for the Twigs IntelliSense VS Code extension and its TypeScript language-server plugin

scripts.package:prepare: cd packages/plugin && npm run build && npm pack && cd ../extension && npm install ../plugin/twigs-intellisense-plugin-*.tgz --no-save
scripts.package: cd packages/plugin && npm run build && npm pack && cd ../extension && npm install ../plugin/twigs-intellisense-plugin-*.tgz --no-save && vsce package
